rows.scope: Design prior art only; read-only projection subscriptions
rows.competing_option: Query snapshots with explicit observers and no mutable middleware chain
rows.decisive_falsifier: In a synthetic trace, swapping two observers changes an admitted effect, current authority or canonical state
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Prefer snapshot/query observers if ordering cannot remain presentation-only without central middleware complexity
rows.provider_free_check: F03: inspect typed event/result separation and reorder observation traces
rows.does_not_prove: Throughput, stable event delivery, or the cheapest observation mechanism

rows.scope: Typed outcomes; rewriting is a proposal subject to fresh admission
rows.competing_option: Separate transform and command handlers without generic continuation interception
rows.decisive_falsifier: A changed action inherits approval for original arguments, or a synthetic answer is recorded as an external-effect receipt
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Drop generic interception if separate handlers preserve meaning with fewer ambiguous paths
rows.provider_free_check: F03/F04: original-versus-rewritten action and synthetic-answer truth tables
rows.does_not_prove: Permission enforcement by the upstream host or semantic equivalence for every event

rows.scope: Candidate bounded presentation over common projections, not renderer choice
rows.competing_option: Fixed built-in views plus external read-only projection clients
rows.decisive_falsifier: A tree callback writes canonical state, changes a grant, or hides required scope/Stop/question information
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Use the fixed-view competitor where contributions cannot preserve shared semantics and accessible fallback
rows.provider_free_check: F04/F09/F11: inspect contribution contract and paired visual/text records
rows.does_not_prove: Non-flicker behavior, human comprehension, toolkit fitness or accessibility

rows.scope: Presentation invalidation may coalesce; authoritative records may not
rows.decisive_falsifier: A skipped intermediate update erases revocation, receipt, replay-gap marker or unresolved question
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Prefer polling if bounded subscription disposal cannot be shown without leaked work
rows.provider_free_check: F08/F09: compare durable-event history to coalesced frame proposals
rows.does_not_prove: Measured idle cost, frame latency or delivered-notification completeness

rows.scope: Manifest/version/digest/dependency concepts only; no format chosen
rows.competing_option: Capabilities built natively with separately declared contribution manifests
rows.decisive_falsifier: Listing an installed-disabled contribution imports code or starts a dependency
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Prefer native declarations if package enumeration cannot remain inert and inspectable
rows.provider_free_check: F06: zero-effect static phase matrix for inventory, admission and activation
rows.does_not_prove: Universal plugin import, license grant, installation safety or zero inventory cost

rows.scope: Comparison candidate; inventory evidence never implies enforcement
rows.competing_option: Manual manifest/capability review plus independent mediation at every effect
rows.decisive_falsifier: An indirect or imported side effect is absent from the inventory and that omission is accepted as authorization
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Keep inventory informational only if completeness cannot be established; broker enforcement still required
rows.provider_free_check: F02/F06: inspect graph and intentionally omitted callback/import effect
rows.does_not_prove: Static analyzer completeness, sandboxing or safe execution

rows.capability: In-session hot reload as production recovery
rows.scope: Avoid unreviewed active-code replacement; watch only disposable development acceleration
rows.competing_option: Digest-bound staged activation at a declared boundary with old-epoch refusal
rows.decisive_falsifier: Candidate reload leaves an old timer/callback active, overwrites persisted truth from defaults, or resumes effects without revalidation
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Narrow to an admitted development-only loop after revision fencing and cleanup receipts are specified; never make it canonical recovery
rows.does_not_prove: Actual cleanup, recovery durability or production safety
rows.conforming_candidate: Disable in-session reload and use immutable process replacement with drain/fence and state revalidation
rows.negative_control: In-session hot reload as production recovery
rows.comparison_scope: Compare two enforcement remedies under identical accepted floors; the avoid disposition applies only to the separate negative control
rows.comparative_falsifier: On identical required traces, one remedy cannot preserve required authority, lifecycle or evidence semantics while the other can; both still face the original decisive falsifier

rows.scope: Never claim this supplies D-029 containment
rows.competing_option: Independently qualified restricted runtime under the same operator-provisioned D-029 direct/induced-flow boundary
rows.decisive_falsifier: Synthetic credential-domain data can leave through file read, environment, tool/process output or network without the independent boundary rejecting it
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Reconsider only a different confined candidate whose complete effect graph respects D-029; not the original full-access design
rows.provider_free_check: F07: enumerate direct and indirect egress graph with synthetic secrets only
rows.does_not_prove: Real OS isolation, complete exfiltration resistance, malicious-host safety or policy compliance
rows.conforming_candidate: Operator-provisioned isolated OS workers with mediated capability-scoped execution

rows.scope: A guard may advise/refuse within its scope; it cannot replace admission

rows.decisive_falsifier: Handler error, reordering, injected allow or absent guard permits a previously denied operation
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: An independently mediated candidate can be considered if its guard disappears without weakening admission; this preserves the exclusion
rows.provider_free_check: F04: timeout, exception, short-circuit and unavailable-policy cases plus permitted control
rows.does_not_prove: Host permission behavior, exhaustive race freedom or safety of all guard implementations
rows.conforming_candidate: Centralized non-overridable sink admission gate using current grants

rows.provider_free_check: F01/F02/F13: old/new schema mismatch and adapter-removal checklist
rows.does_not_prove: Future compatibility, portability, vendor support, route qualification or entitlement
rows.conforming_candidate: Bounded exact-build external adapter removable without native boot/recovery dependency
rows.negative_control: Unstable vendor API as native dependency

rows.decisive_falsifier: Closed pane or interrupted hook produces Full=settled while a child, relauncher, remote node or external effect remains unresolved
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: A separately qualified adapter may report a bounded interruption observation; it still cannot declare rollback
rows.does_not_prove: Physical process termination, remote settlement or external rollback
rows.conforming_candidate: Eager indexed canonical fence and owned-process/external-effect receipts

rows.capability: Second admission path through callbacks or commands
rows.scope: All view/CLI/tool controls compile into the same schema and gate
rows.competing_option: Independently authored command encoders using the same common gate, schema, identity and semantic goldens
rows.decisive_falsifier: UI callback executes with expired grant or old revision while the identical CLI request is rejected
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: An equivalent callback becomes eligible only when it reaches the same gate with same identity/idempotency semantics
rows.provider_free_check: F04/F13/F14: cross-surface equivalence and duplicate/stale requests
rows.does_not_prove: Backend enforcement, authentication or semantic parity of an untested host

rows.capability: Diff helper and fixture port candidates
rows.scope: Potential port only after rights, closure and matched-cost gates; none cleared
rows.competing_option: Clean-room diff/view implementation preserving original bytes and R-K contracts
rows.decisive_falsifier: Missing reuse rights, private host dependency, meaning-changing Unicode treatment or total accepted port cost greater than native rewrite
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Move to a separately admitted port experiment only after counsel resolves rights and the same acceptance corpus is frozen
rows.provider_free_check: F10/F11: source/dependency/rights worksheet and Unicode representation pairs
rows.does_not_prove: Cheaper port, licensed redistribution, binary parity or complete Unicode correctness

rows.scope: Use behavioral questions as prior art; do not copy source or host prompt authority
rows.competing_option: Native context-source adapter from Recursion provenance/authority requirements
rows.decisive_falsifier: Port makes upstream file name or placement confer higher authority, loses source identity, or changes accepted context provenance
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Consider a narrow rights-cleared fixture port after independently specifying required ordering and source identities
rows.provider_free_check: F10/F13: dependency and provenance tables with conflicting instruction origins
rows.does_not_prove: Prompt-injection resistance, host instruction equivalence or lower engineering cost

rows.scope: Avoid direct transplant; retain only independently specified observation requirements
rows.competing_option: Independent immutable cohort receipts with the same complete accounting, unknowns and authorized exporter
rows.decisive_falsifier: Exporter obtains a host credential, sends source content outside grant, or treats unavailable cost as zero
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Consider a new credential-independent exporter with explicit audience/data and complete accounting semantics; no reuse clearance implied
rows.does_not_prove: Billing equivalence, privacy compliance or measured savings
rows.conforming_candidate: Event-linked accounting receipts with an explicitly authorized credential-independent exporter
rows.comparison_scope: Compare two enforcement remedies under identical accepted floors; the avoid disposition applies only to the separate negative control
rows.comparative_falsifier: On identical required traces, one remedy cannot preserve required authority, lifecycle or evidence semantics while the other can; both still face the original decisive falsifier

rows.scope: Existing accessibility requirement, not upstream implementation selection
rows.competing_option: Keyboard-first semantic CLI/text projection alongside fixed TUI views
rows.decisive_falsifier: Text path cannot identify target, action, scope, pending question or unresolved effect shown visually
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Use an independently designed text-first contribution where visual tree cannot preserve task equivalence
rows.provider_free_check: F11: paired semantic records and keyboard action worksheet
rows.does_not_prove: Assistive-technology compatibility or human accessibility without admitted user testing

rows.scope: Prior art for a distinct bounded output capability; no raw control passthrough
rows.competing_option: Semantic notification events rendered by the trusted terminal writer
rows.decisive_falsifier: Untrusted text emits clipboard/cursor/control sequences or a notification includes private content outside audience policy
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Prefer semantic-only notifications if byte-level allowlisting cannot preserve injection and privacy invariants
rows.provider_free_check: F09/F11: escaped literal controls versus permitted notification requests
rows.does_not_prove: Terminal support, race-free writes, confidentiality or mod innovation

rows.scope: Require no mandatory inference on view attach/status/deterministic controls; helper effects explicit
rows.competing_option: Native deterministic command/query service with no loaded extension
rows.decisive_falsifier: Opening a view or handling a status query silently triggers model helper, timer-driven inference or provider fallback
rows.reversal_or_narrowing_condition: Prefer direct native queries if the optional adapter cannot disclose and bound all helper effects
rows.provider_free_check: F06/F12/F14: phase/effect graph and nullable meter worksheet
rows.does_not_prove: Zero total cost, subscription savings or model-free behavior of every upstream API method
